summary.text: Greg Overstreet is a Republican member of the Montana House of Representatives who has represented District 88 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Overstreet earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Washington in 1989 and a law degree from the Seattle University School of Law in 1993, and his career experience includes working as an attorney.
He took office on January 6, 2025, and was assigned to the House Local Government, Education and Judiciary committees for 2025-2026.
